# Working plan: deterministic skill-list ordering

## Context

Users diff skill listings in scripts and reviews. Today the listing renders
registered skill names in whatever order the registry/directory enumeration
yields, so identical installs can print different orders and spurious diffs.
The fix: sort registered skill names deterministically in the existing listing
path before rendering. Skill membership, aliases, metadata and the text/JSON
output formats stay unchanged. Tests must cover mixed-case names and differing
directory enumeration order.

Source: PLAN.md (repo root, commit ce7e491). This draft is the review target;
the current branch (`main`, fixture repo with only CLAUDE.md + PLAN.md) is not.

> Users compare skill listings in scripts and reviews. Make the existing listing
